column1: # File -> capability footprint for the repo map (context/map/repo-map.md), graph scope: src/ and scripts/.
# Format (10x-repo-map / graph-metrics.mjs --modules): <pattern><TAB><capability>. A pattern is a path prefix
# matched on whole segments, or a glob with * (no slash) or ** (anything). Globs win, then the longest prefix.
# Reconstructed 2026-10-27: the original context/map/.work/capabilities.tsv was git-ignored and lost. Rebuilt from
# the map's "Where it lives" column and the attributions the evidence names, then checked by folding the
# dependency-cruiser file graph at 321427c (astro shim, evidence/depcruise/) through it:
# - all 102 figures of the capability table in evidence/3-structure.md:22-40 (prod files, Ca, Ce, intra runtime
#   edges, cross-capability in/out excl. /design) and the 32 edge counts at 3-structure.md:42-67 (the 21 diagram
#   edges and the 11 "into shared" counts): 134 of 134 match;
# - not used for fitting, also matching: 93 capability pairs excl. /design, 48 shared -> other edges from
#   design.astro, design.astro Ce 78, the 15-capability SCC, the top type-only pairs (incl. engine -> catalogue 6).
# Counting conventions that reproduce those figures: runtime edges only; scripts -> scripts edges are build edges
# (excluded); src/env.d.ts and src/styles/global.css are not counted as production files, but the
# Layout.astro -> global.css edge counts as a shared intra edge.
# Not reconstructed: the history-side attribution of tests, docs, CI, Supabase and other non-imported paths
# The known misattributions are kept on purpose (repo-map.md, Limitations): components/tonight/Plan* also catches
# the Planet components, GearShell.astro sits in sites-gear, Welcome.astro in onboarding.
